*Pleass watch previous videos before commenting that I need to put down my dog, ty! Deku is coming home on October 29th! After many weeks of training, healing, court appearances and preparation, my boy will be home where he belongs. I want to thank everyone from the community of staff, volunteers, fosters and adopters from Cincinnati Animal Care, and the community from Dogtok. Without your compassion, advice, networking, kind words, showing up to walk Juni and Clem when I couldn't, and of course donations, I would not have been able to get Deku to a trainer. Because of dogtok I met Kayla, our trainer, who quite literally saved my family by making space for Deku in her program and testified on his behalf. I know there are no guarantees in life, I know that people may think I am crazy. Maybe I am.  I accept the tremendous responsibility that having a dog with a bite record, especially under Avery's Law in Ohio, with understanding of the weight of that label. I bear the scars of my mistake, literally. Life is very different now for a lot of reasons. But I made a commitment when I adopted Deku, and if there is a chance that he can live a safe and happy life, I'm going to take that chance for him. #dekuupdate #dogtok #dogmom #healingjourney #resourceguarding
